info.title: Scanverity Resolution API
info.summary: Feature-gated API for resolution-risk assessments, reconciled usage, deterministic sandbox fixtures and signed webhooks.
info.description: Contract for the implemented private-beta assessment, reconciled-usage, deterministic-sandbox and signed-webhook slice. This document does not assert that the feature flag is enabled in production. It does not provide outcome, trading, investment or position advice. Capabilities marked NOT_YET_AVAILABLE are roadmap vocabulary, not callable operations.

servers.description: Production origin. Access is private-beta and feature-gated; availability is not implied by this specification.

tags.name: Resolution assessments
tags.description: Create and poll account-scoped assessment resources.

tags.name: Webhook endpoints
tags.description: Register account- and environment-scoped signed endpoints, inspect append-only delivery evidence and request non-billable redelivery.

tags.name: Resolution usage
tags.description: Read account-scoped monthly reconciled usage totals and their cursor-paginated evidence events.

x-scanverity-fair-billing.exactCopy: You are charged only when Scanverity releases a new assessment. Cache hits, failed requests and withheld assessments are not billed.
x-scanverity-fair-billing.billablePredicate: status is released and billable is true and metering.disposition is billable
nonBillable: webhook delivery, automatic retry or manual redelivery

x-scanverity-rate-limits.scope: per token and separated by read or request class
x-scanverity-rate-limits.note: A rate limit is a traffic-protection bound, not a purchased quota unit; purchased usage is tracked separately, and neither implies the other.

x-scanverity-webhooks.targetPolicy: Credential-free HTTPS on port 443; public DNS only; validated at registration and again before delivery; validated address pinned; redirects are not followed.

post.summary: Request an assessment of one market
post.description: Requires resolution:request. A valid request creates an accepted resource and schedules assessment work. Replaying the same live idempotency key and canonical payload returns the existing resource with HTTP 202. An svr_sandbox_ token uses only the closed deterministic sandbox catalog and every sandbox result is non-billable. webhook=true requires at least one active pre-registered endpoint in the same account and token environment; inline webhook URLs are never accepted.

withSignedWebhook.summary: Deliver the terminal resource to matching registered endpoints

202.description: Newly accepted or idempotently replayed. A replay returns the resource's current state but never creates a second resource or assessment run.

409.description: The same account, token and unexpired idempotency key were used with a different canonical payload.

error.message: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different payload.

413.description: The JSON request body exceeds 8 KiB.

error.message: The request body is not valid for this endpoint.

422.description: The market is unsupported, or webhook delivery was requested without an active endpoint in the same account and environment.

error.message: The market is outside Scanverity's tracked assessment universe.
Webhook delivery requires a pre-registered webhook endpoint.

get.description: Requires resolution:read. The assessment must belong to the token's account. Reading and polling are never billable.

200.description: The assessment in its current state.

404.description: The identifier is unknown or belongs to another account; both cases have the same response.

error.message: The requested assessment was not found.

get.description: Requires a live Resolution API token with usage:read. Returns the authenticated account's reconciled totals for period, or for the current UTC month when period is omitted. The account is derived only from the bearer token; account selectors are rejected.

200.description: Reconciled totals for one UTC calendar month.

get.description: Requires a live Resolution API token with usage:read. Returns one cursor-paginated page of released usage events for the authenticated account and required UTC month. Cursors are opaque and bound to that account and period; clients must not construct or reuse them across scopes.

200.description: A bounded page of reconciled usage events in release order.

post.description: Requires webhooks:manage. The destination must be credential-free public HTTPS on port 443 and passes DNS/SSRF validation. The signing secret is encrypted at rest and revealed only in this create response. Registration is scoped to the token's account and environment, with at most ten retained endpoint records per environment.

201.description: Endpoint registered. signing_secret is reveal-once and is never returned by later reads.

error.message: The request body is not valid for this endpoint.

get.description: Requires webhooks:manage. Returns only endpoint records owned by the token's account and environment. Signing secrets are never returned.

delete.description: Requires webhooks:manage. Erases the destination and signing secret, cancels pending work and preserves bounded append-only delivery evidence. Unknown, cross-account and cross-environment identifiers share NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Requires webhooks:manage. Returns the newest 50 delivery groups for an endpoint in the same account and environment, including append-only attempt starts and outcomes. Evidence is retained for 90 days. All delivery and redelivery records are non-billable.

post.description: Requires webhooks:manage. For an enabled same-account, same-environment endpoint and a terminal source group, creates a distinct non-billable delivery group with a new delivery_id and redelivery_of pointing to the original. The original group is never rewritten.

202.description: A new audited delivery group was scheduled. Delivery, retry and redelivery are not billable.

bearerToken.description: Reveal-once, account-scoped, environment-bound Resolution API token sent only in Authorization. Legacy svk_ Professional tokens are rejected. Query-string tokens are rejected. All four scope names are deny-by-default; usage:read authorizes only the live reconciled-usage routes, while webhooks:manage authorizes only the endpoint registry and delivery-log operations. Unknown, expired and revoked credentials intentionally share INVALID_TOKEN.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: One to 255 printable ASCII characters, with no leading or trailing whitespace. The binding is scoped to account plus token and retained for exactly 30 days. Same key and canonical payload replay; a different canonical payload returns 409.

UsagePeriodOptional.name: period
UsagePeriodOptional.description: UTC calendar month in YYYY-MM form. Defaults to the current UTC month on the summary route.

UsagePeriodRequired.name: period
UsagePeriodRequired.description: Required UTC calendar month in YYYY-MM form.

UsageCursor.name: cursor
UsageCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page for the same authenticated account and period.

UsageLimit.name: limit
UsageLimit.description: Maximum number of usage events returned in one page.

WebhookEndpointId.name: endpoint_id
WebhookEndpointId.description: Account- and environment-scoped webhook endpoint identifier.

WebhookDeliveryId.name: delivery_id
WebhookDeliveryId.description: Stable webhook delivery-group identifier. Automatic attempts reuse it; manual redelivery creates a new identifier linked by redelivery_of.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value true only when POST returned an existing idempotency-bound resource.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying. Implemented on 429 responses.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests in the token's current 60-second read or request bucket.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current token and class bucket.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Whole seconds until the current token and class window resets.

RateLimit-Scope.description: The read or request bucket consumed by this authenticated operation.

Deprecation.description: Emitted only after a version or operation is formally deprecated. v1 is not currently deprecated.

Sunset.description: HTTP date after which a deprecated operation may stop responding, with at least six months' notice.

BadRequest.description: INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_MARKET, INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, or a token supplied in the URL.

ResolutionUsageBadRequest.description: The query is invalid, the required events period is absent, the cursor is invalid for this account and period, or a token was supplied in the URL.

error.message: Send the token in the Authorization header, never the URL.
period must use YYYY-MM.
The usage cursor is invalid for this account and month.

ResolutionUsageForbidden.description: The credential is valid but is not a live token carrying usage:read.

error.message: A live token with usage:read is required.

ResolutionUsageUnavailable.description: The reconciled usage view could not be read safely or failed its integrity/parity checks. No partial usage data is returned.

error.message: Resolution usage is temporarily unavailable.
Resolution usage is temporarily unavailable.

InvalidToken.description: Unknown, malformed, expired or revoked token. These cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

error.message: The bearer token is invalid, expired or revoked.

InsufficientScope.description: The credential is valid but lacks the operation's scope.

error.message: This token lacks the required scope.

RateLimited.description: The current shared per-token or per-account traffic bound was reached. Rate limiting is not purchased usage.

error.message: Too many requests — slow down and retry.

ProviderUnavailable.description: The live market resolver/provider is temporarily unavailable. No assessment is released and the request is not billable. Deterministic sandbox requests do not use this request-level fallback; the sv-sandbox-failed fixture produces a readable terminal failed resource.

error.message: The assessment provider is temporarily unavailable.

InternalError.description: The request could not be completed safely. No assessment is released and the request is not billable.

error.message: The request could not be completed safely.

WebhookNotFound.description: Unknown endpoint or delivery ID, an identifier owned by another account or environment, a disabled endpoint for redelivery, or a still-pending source delivery. These cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

error.message: The requested webhook resource was not found.

WebhookEndpointLimit.description: The account already retains ten webhook endpoint records in this token environment.

error.message: The webhook endpoint limit for this environment was reached.

UnsafeWebhookTarget.description: The destination is not a safely resolved public HTTPS endpoint.

error.message: The webhook destination is not a safe public HTTPS endpoint.

url.description: Credential-free public HTTPS destination on port 443. DNS and address safety are validated at registration and again before every delivery.

signing_secret.description: Reveal-once secret. It is encrypted at rest and omitted from every later response.

market.description: Stable Polymarket market identifier, supported slug, or supported canonical URL. It is normalized to one internal market identifier.

customer_reference.description: Opaque customer correlation value. It is echoed and never interpreted.

webhook.description: When true, enqueue the terminal assessment for every active endpoint in the same account and token environment that subscribes to the terminal event. If no active endpoint exists, the request returns WEBHOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED. Inline URLs are never accepted. Polling remains available independently.

receipt.description: Present only when a public receipt was successfully published for a live withheld assessment. Omitted for sandbox assessments and whenever no receipt was published.

typical_completion_seconds.description: Indicative behavior, not a completion guarantee or service-level commitment.

classification.description: Open classification vocabulary; clients must preserve unknown future values.

calibrated_estimate.description: A measured null remains null. If the upstream record did not contain this key, it is omitted.

account_id.description: Authenticated account identity. It is never selected by a query parameter.

released.description: Number of released usage evidence events before adjustments.

billable.description: Effective billable units after append-only adjustments.

evaluation_credit.description: Effective non-billable evaluation-credit units after adjustments.

measurement.description: Effective isolated cost-measurement units after adjustments.

adjusted_units.description: Units removed by append-only adjustments in this reconciled period.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor when has_more is true; otherwise null.

exact_rule_fragments: according to Source A or Source B
alternative_interpretations: The two named sources can publish different outcomes.

verified_facts.statement: This is a fixed deterministic sandbox fixture; it is not a live-market claim.

limitations: Deterministic sandbox data only; no live provider or customer data was read.

exact_rule_fragments: The official source must confirm the result.
alternative_interpretations: Confirmation may occur after the named deadline.

limitations: The source carries no explicit publication schedule.

exact_rule_fragments: The official source must confirm the result.
alternative_interpretations: Confirmation may occur after the named deadline.

alternative_interpretations: Confirmation may occur after the named deadline.

withheld.could_not_verify: The market's decisive rules text could not be verified.
withheld.reason: Publishing a resolution-risk assessment without verified rules would be unreliable.

retry.policy: retried when the blocking input changes and at the next scheduled assessment

error.detail: The assessment provider was temporarily unavailable.
